documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Board Meeting Outcome for Change In Designation Of Mr. Rohan Mittal As The "Chief Commercial & Development Officer - MEA"
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Transcript Of The 31St Annual General Meeting Of The Company

analysis.summary: VA Tech Wabag reported record results for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 20.8% year-over-year to INR 887 crores and EBITDA increasing 21.7% to INR 116 crores. The company maintained its net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter at INR 965 crores and achieved a historic high order book of INR 19,400 crores. Management highlighted strong operating momentum, disciplined order intake focused on payment security and technology fit, and ongoing expansion in international markets including the GCC and Europe. VA Tech Wabag Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY 2027, driven by robust international and domestic order wins, top-line momentum, and profitability. The company's order book surged to approximately INR 19,400 crores, supported by a selective bidding approach and new project wins across various geographies including Kuwait, UAE, Austria, and India.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver 15% to 20% revenue growth.
guidance.quote: See we have already guided for a 15% to 20% growth, Shubham, and we are confident of meeting that.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a medium-term EBITDA margin outlook of staying within 13% to 15%.
guidance.quote: And that is why in our medium-term outlook, we gave a blended EBITDA margin outlook of staying within 13% to 15% of EBITDA.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain its medium-term revenue growth guidance at 15% to 20% CAGR.
guidance.quote: 15% to 20% CAGR of revenue, this year we did almost 20% on the higher side of the band.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to remain firmly within the 13% to 15% band.
guidance.quote: EBITDA 13% to 15%, we've firmly remained in that band not just this year, but over the last 2 to 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company targets maintaining an order book of at least 3x of revenues.
guidance.quote: We said we will keep our order book at least 3x of revenues.

guidance.claim: The medium-term outlook is to take the O&M share to 20%.
guidance.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

demand_outlook.claim: Water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization, and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we see a healthy opportunity pipeline across our target markets, growing water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse, particularly in water stressed regions.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite recent geopolitical developments, management has seen no material impact on projects, operations, or underlying demand in the Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the recent geopolitical developments, we have seen no material impact on our projects, operations or underlying demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities even going forward.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities even going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: India presents a total addressable market opportunity of USD 20 billion to USD 25 billion over the next five to seven years.
demand_outlook.quote: India itself is more than $25 billion in next five to seven years.

demand_outlook.claim: Saudi Arabia presents a total addressable market opportunity of over USD 30 billion over the next five to seven years.
demand_outlook.quote: Saudi more than $30 billion in next five to seven years.

demand_outlook.claim: The GCC region is expected to provide an average of USD 5 billion per year of opportunities for the next 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: For the next 10 years, we see an average of $5 billion per year of opportunity.

margins_costs.claim: EPC contributed 82% of revenues while O&M contributed 18% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EPC contributed 82% of the revenues while O&M contributed 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) stood at 19.6% and Return on Equity (ROE) at 16% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: along with delivering healthy returns on capital, with Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) at 19.6% and Return on Equity (ROE) at 16% for this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company closed the year with an EBITDA margin of 13.3% and a PAT margin of 9.4%.
margins_costs.quote: These are the key performance metrics: EBITDA at 13.3%, PAT at 9.4%, closing with a net cash of INR 9,500 crore, return on equity of over 15%, net working capital days hovering around 100 days and our return on capital almost 20%.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake during Q1 was over INR 3,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake during Q1 was over INR 34 billion, over INR 3,400 crores, of which about INR 29.6 billion was EPC and INR 4.7 billion was O&M.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book position reached a historic high of INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book position reached a historic high of INR 194 billion, that is INR 19,400 crores, almost $1.8 billion, which is over four times of our revenue base, providing very strong visibility for execution over the coming quarters and years.

orders_capacity.claim: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in the order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in our order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores, even as we persisted with our selective approach to bidding for projects.

orders_capacity.claim: The company closed the financial year with a record-high order backlog of INR 17,200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Today we have INR17,200 crore of order backlog.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake for the year reached approximately INR 7,500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake we closed with INR 7,500 crore almost that is year-over-year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remained net cash positive for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance of INR 965 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continued our net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance, excluding HAM standing at INR 965 crores as of this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The positive net cash position streak was extended to the 14th consecutive quarter to reach INR 965 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In this quarter, we continued to grow profitably, extending our positive net cash position streak to the 14th consecutive quarter to reach INR 965 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per share for the year.
capital_allocation.quote: And in line with the performance, the board recommended a final dividend of INR 5/- per share, up from INR 4/- last year, recommended to the shareholders for approval.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year with a net cash position of INR 950 crore, excluding investment in HAM.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash, excluding the investment in HAM, is INR 950 crore, because our borrowing is less or more or less close to INR 100 crores because that's the working capital we take because we don't want to break our fixed deposits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Currency and raw material volatility were flagged as potential effects of ongoing geopolitical situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Currency and raw material volatility, this is also something which is an effect of geopolitical situations.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to take the industrial order mix to around 20% to 25% over a period of time.
management_commitments.quote: So, we would say over a period of time, our objective will remain to take industrial order mix to be around 20% to 25%.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects realistically to operate in a 13% to 14% EBITDA margin band for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: And over years, it will certainly improve towards 15% or more depending on the sizes that we are operating.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to increase water positivity by 50% by 2030.
The company is committed to increasing gender diversity among employees through a 12% female employee mix by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Increase gender diversity among employees through 12% female employee mix by 2030

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to take the O&M contribution to 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to cross a 20% ROCE in the next couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: ROCE over 20% we are getting closer to that and I'm sure in the next couple of years we will surely cross 20%.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets maintaining its order book at least 3x of revenues.
management_commitments.quote: We said we will keep our order book at least 3x of revenues.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets revenue growth at a CAGR of 15% to 20%.
management_commitments.quote: 15% to 20% CAGR of revenue, this year we did almost 20% on the higher side of the band.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
